name: guardrails-js
description: Tells Claude when the JavaScript it wrote is unsafe or slow, so it fixes it in the same turn. Node, React, Next, Vue, Nuxt, Angular, Svelte, NestJS, tRPC. No Python, no model calls.

network.title: Check packages online before installing
network.description: Asks osv.dev and the npm registry about a package before it installs, which catches a known vulnerable version of a package you already trust. Package names leave your machine. The offline checks keep working when this is off.

performance.title: Report performance findings
performance.description: Sync work in request handlers, N+1 queries, unbounded fan out, React and Vue render traps. These never interrupt and arrive as quiet notes. Turn off if you only want security findings.

priming.title: Send rules at session start
priming.description: Gives Claude a short rule set for the stack this project actually uses, so it writes it right the first time. Costs about a thousand tokens once per session.
